description: I'm Walt, and this channel is where I cut through the paranoia and the markup on privacy and spy gear. From free 10-minute checks that find hidden cameras and trackers, to honest verdicts on the detectors and gadgets actually worth your money. Whether you travel, live alone, or just want to know nobody's watching, there's something here for you. Subscribe to become a part of this journey.
